verdict.rationale: Sharing availability or inserting bookable meeting times is a fair capability to ask of an email client, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers composing, drafting, labeling, search and AI assistance, but contains nothing about calendar integration, availability sharing or scheduling links. AI-assisted composition is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
